transcription.title: Transcription
transcription.description: Models transcribe on your computer: download them once, then they work offline.
transcription.diarizationDescription: Used by Recognize speakers, next to Transcribe. Recognizes at most 4 speakers.

recording.title: Recording and audio
recording.liveModeDescription: Only with Both: Separate inputs transcribes the microphone and system audio each on its own, as a conversation, with two instances of the model (twice the memory).
recording.parlantiDescription: After Stop, on the phrases of the live transcription: with separate inputs it chooses which inputs. It recognizes at most 4 speakers per audio and needs the speaker recognition model.

general.title: General
general.description: The Library folder, the Copy text format, the theme and the interface language.
general.folderDescription: Where Sbobino saves Bini: its folders are the Collections. Created if it doesn't exist; changing it doesn't move the Bini of the previous folder.
general.languageRestart: The new language takes effect the next time Sbobino starts.

assistants.title: Assistants
assistants.description: Claude and Codex can search and read your Bini through an MCP server, even when Sbobino is closed.
assistants.allow: Allow assistants to read the Library
assistants.allowDescription: Assistants search and read the titles and text of your Bini without changing them. What they read goes to Anthropic's or OpenAI's servers: it leaves your PC.
assistants.connectDescription: Copy the configuration into the assistant and restart it.
assistants.claudeCode: Claude Code: run the command in a terminal
